metadata.prerequisites: Passed ENT403 or Level 5 LUK or TRS501 or equivalent
metadata.description:
"This course is designed to further develop the learner's confidence and fluency in using the English language and to enrich their learning experience through interactive lessons and communicative exercises.
Upon completion of the course, students should be able to:
- Identify main ideas and supporting details; analyze cohesive devices (pronouns, conjunctions, transitional phrases); Create appropriate graphic organizers (mind maps, Venn diagrams, flowcharts) for different text types.
- Demonstrate improved reading fluency, recognize and use rhetorical techniques.
- Analyze textual references to visuals and interpret information presented in charts, graphs, diagrams, and infographics.
- Identify and understand statements of acts and opinions, identify implication and inference,
- Identify and evaluate evidence and argumentation; understand multiple perspectives and evaluate sources
- Recognize and understand definitions and classifications within a text
- Organize and structure ideas effectively at the sentence, paragraph, and essay levels in academic writing.
- Deliver clear, well-organized, and impactful oral presentations with appropriate academic register and confidence.
- Master (300) academic vocabulary words from the Academic Word List, demonstrating accuracy on vocabulary assessments and correctly using target words in their written assignments and oral presentations.
Students are also expect to:
- Be cooperative, supportive, and responsible in group work
- Take advantages of AI, online applications, language labs, and online platforms in performing learning tasks
- Adhere to plagiarism rules in performing learning tasks.
- Demonstrate critical thinking
metadata.student_tasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfil tasks given by the instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes
- Use the Student Access Code provided with the textbook
- Access the course website for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ1
constructive_questions.details: Think about sports in your home country or some other country you know well: Is there a sport that is considered the “national sport”? Why are so many people interested in that sport? Do people think the sport somehow relates to the strengths and virtues of that country?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ2
constructive_questions.details: What is SKIMMING? What are some skimming techniques? Apply the skimming techniques, state the main idea of the reading "Memories that define the self"- SKILL 1, coursebook. In your opinion, what are contributing factors shaping the self of each person?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ3
constructive_questions.details: What is SCANNING? What are some scanning techniques? Based on the reading "NATIONLISM and SPORTS"- SKILL 2, coursebook, state how you scan the answers for the given questions?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ4
constructive_questions.details: In your opinion, how can sports buoy patriotism and nationalism?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ5
constructive_questions.details: What is note-taking? What are some ways of note-taking? How useful is note-taking? Based on the reading "Athletics in ancient time", what and how key words and key information should be note-taken?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ6
constructive_questions.details: How important were athletics in ancient Greece and the Roman world? What are some differences and similarities between the 2 cultures in the way citizens engaged in the games and how they viewed their purpose?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ7
constructive_questions.details: Think of sports events you have watched in person, on TV, or online: What are some examples of warlike language used in sportscasting? What are some reasons such language is used in sports? Can you think of any situations in which an athlete used his or her role on the world stage to promote a personal political or nationalistic viewpoint?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ8
constructive_questions.details: What are some similarities between sports and wars? How can sports used to reduce regional or international conflicts?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ9
constructive_questions.details: Choose five countries that you know something about. What is each country’s strongest product or service? Does it trade that product or service internationally? Why or why not? Think of a country that is facing international competition. How should it respond to this situation?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ10
constructive_questions.details: What is a paragraph? What functions do sentences in a paragraph perform? What are the features of each type? Find a paragraph and analyze the functions of its sentences.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ11
constructive_questions.details: Based on the reading " Comparative Advantages Theory in a global economy", what functions does each sentence carry? In your opinion, how important is it for an economy to recognize its comparative advantages?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ12
constructive_questions.details: What is the topic of a text? How is it identified? What is the main idea of a paragraph? What are ways to identify its main idea? Choose a reading text and identify its topic and main idea.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ13
constructive_questions.details: Do a research on Patriotic Purchasing and some other protectionist measures: How is each measure defined? What are some of their features? What benefits and negative impact do the policies have on an economy? In your opinion, should people buy domestically manufactured products to show their patriotism?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ14
constructive_questions.details: What is sanction? What are some reasons some countries threaten to other countries?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ15
constructive_questions.details: Do a research on a sanctioned country and state specific reasons why this country has been sanctioned? What negative consequences does it suffer from? What has been done to deal with the problem? In your opinion, should the sanction be allowed?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ16
constructive_questions.details: What is the difference between a virus and a bacteria? Which one is more dangerous? What is the difference between a viral infection and a bacterial infection?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ17
constructive_questions.details: Do a research on cohesion and state its definition, its common patterns. How is each of the following patterns (cause-effect, compare-contrast, problem-solution) characterized? For each pattern, write a paragraph for illustration and analyze how the information in each paragraph pieced?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ18
constructive_questions.details: What is vaccine? How does it work? Compare and contrast live attenuated vaccines and inactivated vaccines.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ19
constructive_questions.details: Should we test new vaccines, medicines and cosmetics on animals? If you think “yes” What animals should be used and what animals should not be used?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ20
constructive_questions.details: Why do some people choose to be anti-vaxxers? Should the government force everyone to get vaccinated? If yes, why? What diseases should be vaccinated against? If not, why?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ21
constructive_questions.details: Study the reading "Poliovirus" and state major polio-related events and facts within 1950s and 2016. What can be summarized about the oral polio vaccination? Compare and contrast nations with and without widespread cases of polio. What are modern attempts to eradicate the polio virus? Use outlines and graphic organizers to demonstrate your answers.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ22
constructive_questions.details: Some people think that vaccination and treatment for serious diseases like polio should be free of charge. What's your opinion?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ23
constructive_questions.details: What are the main steps in creating DNA vaccines? What are some differences between DNA vaccines and attenuated vaccines? (components, safety, immunity) ? What is one reason why DNA vaccines remain in clinical trial?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ24
constructive_questions.details: What is your personal definition of education? How has education been defined by different scholars? If you could change your current educational system, what would that entail?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ25
constructive_questions.details: Who was Alexander the Great? By what he did in the past, what can you tell about his personalities?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ26
constructive_questions.details: Who was Aristotle? What were the key features of his teaching? What was his relationship with Alexander the Great?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ27
constructive_questions.details: Research about Plato's academy. What was it? What was so special about it?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ28
constructive_questions.details: What is "ambiguity" in reading? What factors create "ambiguity"? Why do you have to "tolerate" it?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ29
constructive_questions.details: Research about Confucius. Who was he? How did he influence Eastern culture?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ30
constructive_questions.details: Who was Socrates? What were the key features of his teaching? Compare them with Confucius's.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ31
constructive_questions.details: Many argue that modern education should ignore traditional values. Do you agree or disagree?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ32
constructive_questions.details: What is particle pollution? What are its effects? Search for information about programs aiming to decrease particle pollution. Choose one program. Has it been successful in reducing particle pollution?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ33
constructive_questions.details: What negative impacts do internal combustion engines have on air quality and human health? What solutions should be recommended to deal with the problems?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ34
constructive_questions.details: Research about a hybrid-electric vehicle and state how it is structured, how it works, what benefits it brings about, what problems the vehicle may cause..

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ35
constructive_questions.details: Why do locations of big sports events such as the Olympics tend to have poor air quality? What are the health risks that athletes may face due to the air quality? What can be some air quality control measures during sports events?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ36
constructive_questions.details: Consider your own personal identity: student, friend, waitress, churchgoer, and so forth. How have your experiences and relationships shaped this identity? If you were to work with others to achieve a goal you believe in, what impact do you think your identity could have on this work?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ37
constructive_questions.details: What is the differences between statements of opinion and those of fact? What are the features of a statement of opinion? What are the features of a statement of fact?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ38
constructive_questions.details: Who was Gandhi? What is his Civil Disobedience style? What were the two Civil Disobedience campaigns that Gandhi led which contributed to the Independence of India? How did Gandhi's Civil Disobedience style affect the Civil Right Movement of the American?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ39
constructive_questions.details: What is a critique? Are critique and criticism the same? What is the difference between them? What are the characteristics of a critique? What are some signpost expressions that limit or define to introduce the criteria of a critique?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ40
constructive_questions.details: Think of a country you know well. Does the government impose any extra taxes on items brought in from other countries? Why or why not? Do the taxes work as the government intends?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ41
constructive_questions.details: What is the difference between "inference" and "implication" ? What are some reasons authors use implication in their writing? Find a paragraph and analyze the implications the author use and state what you can infer from those implications?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ42
constructive_questions.details: What is tariff? What are the positive effects of tariff on national economy? Discuss the negative impacts of tariff on research and development for long term national economy growth.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ43
constructive_questions.details: What are sin taxes? What are the examples of sin taxes? Why is sin tax implemented? Do sin taxes really change the consumer behavior?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ44
constructive_questions.details: What are public goods? What are some features of public goods. What are the main differences between public goods and private goods?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ45
constructive_questions.details: How does cancer develop? Is cancer incidence rate rising or falling? Are some people more susceptible to cancer than others? What are the causes of cancer?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ46
constructive_questions.details: What are the advancements in the diagnosis and treatment of cancer? What types of advances do you think will be made in the future, both in the prevention and the treatment of cancer?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ47
constructive_questions.details: What does faulty rhetoric mean? Can you provide some examples of faulty rhetoric? List out some common rhetoric faults and find one example for each of the type listed.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ48
constructive_questions.details: What are the causes and symptoms of mad cow disease? When and where did the epidemic first break out? How was the epidemic stopped then?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ49
constructive_questions.details: Vaccines against some cancer-causing viruses are currently in development. Do you know of any cancer-causing viruses? What could be the benefits of being able to use vaccines to fight against cancer?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ50
constructive_questions.details: Why are vaccines against HPV of special importance? What are the recent advances in the field of cancer-prevention vaccines? What is your opinion on the use of vaccines to fight against cancer?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ51
constructive_questions.details: How do different cultures view the underworld? Research some sources and synthesize your information.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ52
constructive_questions.details: Does superstition play an important role in your culture? Do you believe in life after death? Do your beliefs about death and underworld affect how you live your life?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ53
constructive_questions.details: What are some criteria to evaluate the credibility of sources? Explain each criterion and give examples for illustration. State the sources you consider credible or incredible in the reading text " Greek and Roman Funeral Belief"- Skill 2- Unit 4- Part 2.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ54
constructive_questions.details: Why do some cultures mourn death and others celebrate it? What are some funeral customs in your country?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ55
constructive_questions.details: Consider the seven stages of a hero's journey, choose a real hero and describe how he/she experienced each stage. Did he/she experienced all the 7 stages? If not, explain why.

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ56
constructive_questions.details: What do you think the qualities of a hero are? What do you think of this quote: “We can all be heroes in our virtues, in our homes, in our lives”?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ57
constructive_questions.details: How has air- conditioning changed over the years? What are the advantages and disadvantages of air conditioners?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ58
constructive_questions.details: Is air-conditioning necessary? Why or why not?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ59
constructive_questions.details: What is CLASSIFICATION? What are some characteristics of a good classification? What is a basis of classification? Read the text " Indoor Air Pollutants and Health" (p. 245) - How are indoor air pollutants classified? What is its basis?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ60
constructive_questions.details: What are the common causes of indoor air pollution? What are the effects on human health?

constructive_questions.name: HN_CQ61
constructive_questions.details: What is the sick building syndrome? What are the symptoms, causes and how to prevent it?
